r: Konami Digital Entertainment Fan Promotion Official Rules

r.b: A PURCHASE WILL NOT INCREASE ODDS OF WINNING. ENTRY INTO THE PROMOTION CONSTITUTES ACCEPTANCE OF THESE OFFICIAL RULES.

These Official Rules apply to the 300th YCS Richmond 2026 Survey Sweepstakes (the “Promotion”). One (1) fan will win one (1) Time Wizard plush toy by attending the 300th YCS Richmond 2026 event during the weekend of February 14-15, 2026 and completing a survey. One (1) entry will be randomly selected from the pool of eligible entries to win the Time Wizard plush toy. Entries will only be accepted during the Term (defined below) of the Promotion.
Entries must attend the 300th YCS Richmond 2026 event in-person and complete all survey questions in order to win. Entries will only be accepted during the Term (defined below) of the Promotion.

r: To be eligible to participate in the Promotion, you must be (i) thirteen (13) years of age or older on the date of entry, and (ii) in attendance at the 300th YCS Richmond 2026 in Richmond, Virginia, USA taking place February 14-15, 2026. Employees, representatives, officers, and directors of Sponsor (defined below), its affiliates, subsidiaries, agents (collectively, the “Promotion Entities”), as well as immediate family (spouse, parents, siblings, and children) and household members of such employees are not eligible. All federal, state, and local laws apply.
: Konami Digital Entertainment, Inc., 1 Konami Way, Hawthorne, CA 90250

: The Promotion will begin February 14, 2026 at 7:00 am Eastern Time (“ET”) and end February 15, 2026 at 3:00 pm ET (the “Term”). Unless otherwise noted, for all times provided in these Official Rules or in relation to the Promotion, the applicable time zone will be Eastern Time. The Sponsor’s computer is the official time keeping device for the Promotion. The drawing will take place on February 15, 2026 at 3:30 pm ET (the “Drawing Date”).

r.b: During the Term, while attending the 300th YCS Richmond 2026 event, entrants must complete all questions in the survey (the link for the survey will be made available at the event) and submitting the survey to receive one (1) sweepstakes entry. After the Term, one (1) qualifying entry will be randomly selected to win one (1) Time Wizard plush toy. Winner must be present to win.

r: Your entry must be within the general spirit of the Promotion and meet the following requirements:
Must not violate or infringe the rights of others including, without limitation, patent, trademark, trade secret, copyright, publicity, privacy or other proprietary rights
Must not impersonate or misrepresent your affiliation with any person or entity;

Must not be unlawful, threatening, abusive, harassing, defamatory, libelous, deceptive, fraudulent, invasive of another’s privacy, tortuous, or contain explicit or graphic descriptions or accounts of, sexual acts, or otherwise contain any other content that is objectionable;
Must not victimize, harass, degrade, or intimidate an individual or group of individuals on the basis of religion, gender, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, age, or disability;
Must be within the general spirit and guidance of the Promotion, including meeting the terms of these Official Rules;
Must not contain an advertisement or solicitation not affiliated with the Sponsor;
Must not contain any musical recording or compilation; and
Must not contain imagery, content, recording or other element that is owned by a third party.

Each person is limited to one entry. Entries using automatic entry will be disqualified. Entries using multiple accounts will be disqualified. Entrants agree to be bound by the terms of these Official Rules and by the decisions of Sponsor, which are final and binding. Entries will be considered void if they are in whole or in part illegible, incomplete, damaged, irregular, altered, counterfeit, produced in error, forged, mechanically reproduced or obtained through fraud or theft, or if they contain material that does not meet the requirements described in these Official Rules.
Sponsor reserves the right, in its sole and absolute discretion, to refuse to accept any entry for any reason.
Completing an entry constitutes your agreement to these Official Rules. To be eligible, Sponsor must receive your entry within the Term.
Sponsor will award one (1) prize, consisting of one (1) Time Wizard plush toy. Approximate retail value: $37.99 USD ($48.40 CAD). Odds of winning depend on the number of eligible entries received.

Promotional images may differ from actual prize. Actual value may vary. Winner will be responsible for all costs and taxes associated with winning the prize. Prize awarded as-is. The Sponsor may, at its sole discretion, choose to substitute the prize with another of comparable or greater value. No prize transfer, assignment or cash or other substitution by the prize winner is permitted. If any prize or prize notification is returned as undeliverable, the prize will be considered forfeited and the Sponsor will select an alternate prize winner from all remaining eligible entries. The Promotion Entities will not be liable for unsuccessful efforts to notify any potential Prize winner.
: On Drawing Date, Sponsor will randomly select one (1) potential winner from all eligible entries received. The potential winner will be announced at the 300th YCS Richmond 2026 event at 3:30 pm PT.

r.b: The winner must be present to win

r: as well as complete and sign an affidavit of eligibility and liability/publicity release and submit certain personal information, including but not limited to birthday, location, and legal name. If the winner is a minor, his/her parent or legal guardian must execute the affidavit of eligibility and liability/publicity release on his/her behalf. If potential winner is not present and/or does not come forward to claim the prize within five (5) minutes of the announcement of winner, or if a potential winner does not complete such affidavit of eligibility, Sponsor reserves the right to disqualify the individual selected and select at random an alternate potential winner following the same process.

Except where prohibited by law, by accepting a prize, a prize winner consents to the Promotion Entities’ use of his/her likeness, photograph, name, biographical information, entry, and/or voice for advertising and publicity purposes in any and all media worldwide (including winners list) without additional compensation or notification. The name and city/state/country of residence of the prize winner may be utilized in communications and advertising, including being posted on the websites of the Promotion Entities.
